notes.title: New level release
notes.content:
And with that, the first of the new levels is complete and ready to play. Welcome to the pirate bay, where you must make your way past skeleton pirates and across an ocean to make it to the flag on the pirate ship.

Now its time to start working on the next levels to be added. Hope yall enjoy!!!

notes.title: Some updates for Boxman
notes.content:
Sup everyone, hope the new year has been treating everyone well.

 To start of the new year we wanted to announce that some of the graphics have been worked on and official controller mapping is in the works. 


Along with that the first of the additional levels is almost completed so just hold on a little longer and there will be some more content added. 

See yall next time,
Bethwell Studios
